pages.text: $(li)Dragonsteel Harmonic Lattice costs $(l)1 MB$(); gilded matter and the spire resource chains are the hard part.$(li)Costs: Shard of the Cosmos ~78k EMC, Gilded Matter 3M, Harmonic Fluid Lattice 19.1M mB.
$(li)Total material needs: ~1,800 hypercubics, ~336,875 balanced casings, ~441,435 hyperuranion actualizing fabrials, ~5,026,125 mythic excavation reactors (at ~4.65 crafts/s).
$(li)Watch gilded matter chains closely; they're a key bottleneck.
